evals.prompt: 如何发布这个 .NET 库为 NuGet 包，外部消费者怎么安装？
evals.expected_output: Applies the release workflow: version bump across all four touchpoints, clean restore, pack with -p:Version, inspect the nupkg, consumer verification.
assertions: Bumps version in all four touchpoints

evals.prompt: 想发布一个包但把领域 DLL 嵌进去，不声明依赖。
evals.expected_output: Uses PrivateAssets=all + None Pack to embed the domain DLL into the RCL nupkg, with a clean restore before pack.
assertions: Embeds the domain assembly in the nupkg
Verifies nuspec has no dependency on it

evals.prompt: 写 nuget.org 页面自动渲染的 package README，包含安装片段和快速开始。
evals.expected_output: Writes a consumer-focused package-readme.md with one-line positioning, install snippet, real demo Quick Start (public types only), capabilities, absolute doc links; one-line paragraphs, no trailing blank.
assertions: Quick Start uses only public published types
Enforces one-line paragraphs and no trailing blank line

evals.prompt: CI pack 任务 NU1102 找不到包，构建和格式化却通过。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the missed version touchpoint (CI pack step) and greps the whole repo for the old version before the release PR.
assertions: Finds the stale CI pack version
Greps all four touchpoints for the old version

evals.prompt: 把包发布到 GitHub Packages NuGet registry。
evals.expected_output: Uses classic PAT write:packages only, adds the source at user-level config, pushes with --api-key, notes first publish is private.
assertions: Writes the source to the user-level config
Hands token commands to the user, never types the token

evals.prompt: 验证消费者示例解析的是刚打的本地包。
构建 RCL 组件库本身的结构。
evals.expected_output: Routes RCL structure work to ada-dotnet-blazor-library.

evals.prompt: 编辑了 .NET 工程，需要跑构建测试格式门禁。
提交前做一次代码评审。
